details.description: Buy Grade 1 energy efficiency appliances for a 20% subsidy (up to ¥2000 per item); Grade 2 energy efficiency gets a 15% subsidy (up to ¥1500)
details.example: Air conditioner originally priced at ¥8000; the national subsidy reduces it by ¥1600

details.description: Stackable with a JD recycling coupon worth up to ¥600 each; no brand or category restriction on the old unit
details.example: Buy a ¥4199 cabinet air conditioner: first deduct a ¥600 recycling coupon, then apply the 20% national subsidy, for a final price of ¥2879

details.description: JD PLUS members get a '600 off 6,000' coupon, plus cross-store discounts of 50 off every 299 spent
details.remarks: One day only on May 24; the offline event in Weifang also offers prizes such as an iPhone 16 in a lucky draw

details.description: Pro members who buy 4 categories worth 8,000 yuan pay 95% of the price (5% off); buying designated new products (such as the condensate-free water heater) stacks with other offers to save nearly 1,000 yuan
